headline: CLONE — the twelfth spell lands on MAGIC CARPET
lede: The never-dry stage sent slot a to the shelf's weakest title and shipped its oldest open gap: creature-cloning, the last entry of the original's later-game spell roster. Fly over a pack, press =, and every beast under your ring stands twice — doubled bounty, doubled danger — while the land, the pearls and the wizard's uniqueness stay untouched.

notes.text: CLONE (cost 35): every creature within the look-ring gains a twin mirrored across the cast point at full health — cold, deterministic, wizard never clones. Twelve grimoires now scatter each world; key =, tray slot 12, jade birth-sparkles and an echoed two-note cast.

The bigger book shifted the world rng and seed 33 ambushed the demo bot off the spawn ridge. Root cause: altitude-armor read the ground under the carpet while ridge wolves bite from their own hill — and the climb command silently cancelled against the descent. The bot now reads the wolf's terrain and releases its own down-key: 60/60 seeds, slower than before but 3k ticks faster than the last record.

Twelve new carpetcheck gates (mirror spot, bounty economy, cold-land promise, no-free-mana, wizard-unique, tray 12, determinism), and the mutant proof: delete the twin spawn and three gates die. Also logged a merge-loop hazard: the gh shim says state=completed, never SUCCESS — the rule-5 wait loop spun blind for 15 minutes before the conclusion was read by hand (#1676).
